contract: OpenID Connect login/callback/logout/auto-redirect flow parity with upstream OpenIDAuthStrategy, including settings side effects.

invariants.contract: Web auto-registration success redirects to the configured callback with tokens and persists the provider subject, user fields, and exactly one refresh session; provider error, state replay, expired ID token, and disabled auto-registration match upstream response routing and create no additional user or session.
exceptions: Evidence covers the named web flow cases only; it does not establish all callback cookies, mobile, or event behavior.

invariants.contract: When authOpenIDMatchExistingBy=email finds an active unlinked user, callback links the provider subject to that user, creates one session, and retains the existing extraData member order when appending authOpenIDSub.
Successful OIDC auto-registration emits one user_added payload with the legacy browser user shape to root/admin sockets and does not deliver it to an ordinary user socket.
exceptions: Evidence covers the selected auto-registration event and admin-versus-reader recipient distinction only; the full Socket.IO event matrix remains open.

invariants.contract: Web OIDC callback rejects ID tokens with an invalid nonce, issuer, audience, or RS256 signature using upstream redirect behavior, without changing the resulting user or session state.
exceptions: Evidence covers the four named invalid-token cases using the local mock provider; it does not establish all token validation rules or the complete OIDC flow.

invariants.contract: The selected mobile flow validates redirect allowlist and S256 PKCE inputs, forwards provider state/challenge, matches complete Express redirect responses (status, Location, content type, content length and body) to the provider and app, consumes state once, and matches the replay error response.
exceptions: Covers one mobile URI and S256 authorization flow; callback cookie attributes, state expiry, mobile app token exchange, other URI schemes, and general Socket.IO behavior remain open.

invariants.contract: On selected web OIDC success, start cookies and callback cookies match upstream cookie names, stable values, Max-Age, Path, Expires, HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite attributes; the signed connect.sid is present. Redirect JWT algorithm and claims match after normalizing UUID identifiers and timestamps, and the returned ID-token nonce is bound to that server flow.
exceptions: Evidence covers the selected web auto-registration and email-link success cases; failure/logout cookie clearing, additional proxy/security modes, and every callback branch remain unverified.

invariants.contract: A successful mobile OIDC exchange accepts the app-supplied PKCE verifier, returns the API login payload with matching token claims, persists one active provider-linked user and exactly one session; replay after consuming the callback session returns HTTP 400 No session with upstream Express response headers.
exceptions: Only one local RS256 provider, redirect URI, S256 flow, and auto-registration path are covered; invalid-verifier/provider error handling remains unverified.

invariants.contract: After a valid mobile OIDC authorization and mobile redirect, a callback with an incorrect PKCE verifier matches the upstream login redirect failure (302 to /login?error=Unauthorized&autoLaunch=0), creates no provider-linked user/session, and consumes the one-time callback flow so replay returns 400 No session. The pinned strategy stores the mobile redirect URI string in session.mobile while Auth.js checks session.mobile === true, so valid mobile callback failures follow the web redirect branch.

After a successful web OIDC login, POST /logout with the issued cookies returns the Express JSON response and weak ETag, clears refresh_token, auth_method, and openid_id_token with the source cookie attributes, regenerates connect.sid, and removes the active refresh session without deleting the provider-linked user. The OIDC differential normalizes connect.sid values, so OIDC-specific replacement remains unverified.
exceptions: Evidence uses no configured end-session URL. Logout with provider redirect, allDevices=1, missing/invalid refresh credentials, response/session failure, and mobile logout remain unverified.

invariants.contract: A web OIDC callback using the same browser session remains valid after more than ten minutes but before the upstream 24-hour session TTL; callback route/tokens/cookies and provider-linked persisted user/session state match.
exceptions: One callback after 10 minutes with no intervening requests is covered. The exact 24-hour boundary and rolling session-touch renewal remain unverified.

invariants.contract: A mobile redirect URI mapping expires after ten minutes; the callback response matches upstream after expiry.
exceptions: One allowlisted audiobookshelf://oauth URI and S256 flow after 10 minutes is covered; exact expiry boundary and other schemes remain unverified.

evidence: go-backend/contracts/parity/oidc-differential-report.json (pinned upstream v2.37.2: 24 local mock-provider cases matched; exact limits in provenance)
exceptions: Exact 24-hour session expiry and rolling session-touch renewal, failure/logout cookie clearing, other callback variants, and general Socket.IO event inventory remain unverified.
OIDC capability normal/error/edge categories and repeat/changed state scenarios remain unverified as a whole despite the named verified invariants; no full OIDC parity claim is made.
Force/refresh is not an OIDC operation in the pinned route contract; the capability has no force scenario.

Review M1 follow-up (2026-10-30): F05 now implements and differentially verifies local login/logout connect.sid regeneration, including actual-cookie login → repeated logout relationships. OIDC start/callback/logout value relationships remain open because oidc-differential normalizes connect.sid values; do not infer OIDC value parity from the local-session evidence.
